overall: The AG found the Board intentionally violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing unnoticed variance topics and holding a meeting without legally required notice filing, and referred the matter to hearing with recommended penalties and training.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed zoning variances for two Washington St./Iffley Rd. projects at its Sept. 15, 2015 meeting although the posted notice did not list them.
allegations.key_passage: We find that Board discussed a topic during its September 15, 2015 meeting that was not included on the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Board posted the Sept. 15, 2015 notice only on the City website, without filing it with the City Clerk or posting it at City Hall, where Boston's required notice location is.
allegations.key_passage: the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to file a notice for its September 15, 2015 meeting with the City Clerk and by holding a meeting for which the legally required notice had not been published.

remedy: A civil penalty of $1,000 (recommended, referred to a hearing under 940 CMR 29.07(3)).
Mandatory attendance by all Board members at an Open Meeting Law training conducted by the Division of Open Government (recommended).
An order of immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25 (recommended).
